001: Hello, I'd like to apply for a passport. What documents do I need?
Please take a number and wait in line first, then fill out the application form.
Okay, where can I get the application form?
At the service desk by the entrance. You can go there to pick one up.
Thank you. How long does it usually take to get a passport?
It usually takes seven business days, or three days for expedited service.
002: Excuse me, is this the window for getting a household registration certificate?
Yes, please show me your ID card and household register.
Okay, I brought them. Do I need photocopies?
Yes, you can prepare them at the copy area over there.
I see. How much does it cost?
The household registration certificate is free. There's no charge.
003: Hello, I'd like to ask about the process for transferring social security.
You first need to go to your original insured location to process the transfer-out.
What documents do I need to bring there?
Just bring your ID card and social security card.
After the transfer-out, do I need to come here to register?
Yes, you bring the transfer-out certificate here to process the transfer-in.
004: Where can I renew my driver's license when it expires?
At the vehicle management office window on the second floor. You'll need a medical exam report.
Where do I get the medical exam done?
There's a medical exam station on the first floor lobby. It's very convenient.
Okay, how long does the renewal take?
If all your documents are complete, you can get the new license on the spot.
005: Hello, I'd like to apply for a business license. What are the procedures?
You first need to have your business name approved, then submit the materials.
Is the name approval done online?
Yes, you can apply on the government services website.
After submitting the materials, how long until it's approved?
Usually three business days. You'll be notified by text message once it's approved.
006: Excuse me, do both husband and wife need to be present for a property transfer?
Yes, both of you must be present in person to sign and confirm.
What if one of us is abroad and can't come back?
Then you'll need to get a notarized power of attorney, and the authorized person can handle it on your behalf.
Where do I go to get the notarization done?
You can go to the notary office. Bring the relevant documents with you.
007: Hello, I'd like to register my child's birth.
Okay, please provide the birth certificate and both parents' ID cards.
Do I need to bring the marriage certificate too?
Yes, and you'll also need to bring the household register.
Okay, how long does this take?
If all the documents are complete, it can be done the same day.
008: How do I apply for unemployment benefits?
You first need to register as unemployed, then submit your application.
Where do I register as unemployed?
Right here at the employment services window in this lobby.
After applying, how long until I start receiving the money?
Once your application is approved, the payment will be deposited next month.
009: Hello, I'd like to check my housing fund balance.
You can check it by swiping your ID card on the self-service machine.
Where is the self-service machine? What if I don't know how to use it?
It's to the right of the entrance. There's a staff member nearby who can help you.
Okay, what are the requirements for withdrawing the housing fund?
You need to meet certain conditions, such as buying a house, renting, or retirement.
010: What documents do I need for a residence permit?
You need your ID card, a rental contract, and proof of residence.
Where do I get the proof of residence?
It can be issued by your landlord or your local community office.
Okay, how long is the residence permit valid for?
It's valid for one year, and you'll need to renew it before it expires.
